en.headline: Science Museum hosts food science exhibition on cha chaan teng classics until late October
en.dek: The '創味盤中餐' display explores the science behind pineapple buns, egg tarts and milk tea, alongside molecular gastronomy and future food trends, running until 28 October.
body: The Hong Kong Science Museum is presenting the '創味盤中餐' exhibition in collaboration with the Consulate General of France in Hong Kong and Macau, running until 28 October in the ground-floor exhibition hall.

The display, tied to the French Science Festival theme of 'science of taste', examines the science of cooking, including molecular gastronomy techniques, and features a Hong Kong-style section that breaks down the texture, aroma and flavour of cha chaan teng staples such as pineapple buns, egg tarts and milk tea.

It also covers sustainable diets, food for seniors and space food. Admission is included with the regular exhibition hall ticket; full-time students and museum pass holders enter free. The museum is closed on Thursdays except public holidays.
Organisers said the exhibition aims to let visitors explore everyday food from a scientific perspective through interactive elements.

zh.headline: 科學館「創味盤中餐」展覽至10月底 探索茶餐廳美食科學
zh.dek: 展覽拆解菠蘿包、蛋擔、奶茶背後原理，並介紹分子料理及未來飲食，展期至10月28日。
body: 香港科學館與法國駐港澳總領事館合作，在地下展覽廳舉行「創味盤中餐」展覽，展期至10月28日。
展覽配合法國科學節「滋味科學」主題，探索烹飪背後的科學原理，包括分子料理技術，並設「港式滋味」專區，從口感、香氣及風味角度拆解菠蘿包、蛋擔、奶茶等茶餐廳經典美食。
內容亦涵蓋可持續飲食、長者膳食及太空食品。入場已包括在常設展覽廳門票內，全日制學生及持有效博物館通行證者免費。科學館逢星期四休館（公眾假期除外）。
主辦單位表示，希望透過互動展品，讓參觀者以科學角度重新認識日常飲食。
